capabilities: Visualize character, foreshadowing and hook relations in a graph view
Order scenes on a timeline with dates edited in frontmatter
Outline and reorder plot beats on a multi-column fission board
Plant and resolve foreshadowing and hooks from selected sentences
Track writing goals, word frequency, naming and proofreading with assistant tools
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly) and requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later. Works fully offline with no telemetry; only dictionary downloads and a user-entered URL fetch reach the network. Apache-2.0 licensed; bundles three.js, Chart.js, 3d-force-graph, MiniSearch, jsdiff, relation-graph and CC-CEDICT. Ships a loadable sample work and a Chinese/English README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for planning and tracking long-form fiction, such as foreshadowing state, scene timelines, story relations and world maps.
summary: All-in-one writing suite for long-form fiction that adds graph, timeline, fission board, map, cards and table views over plain Markdown notes.
